summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.31/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.31 a gallon across Wisconsin as of November 25, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 23¢ lower than a week ago, $1.21 lower than a month ago, and 59¢ higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Eau Claire ($3.01) and the highest in Mosinee ($3.65).
